searchText: Hi all, I've updated the Deneb builder-spec changes PR to reflect some recent changes (mainly to include blob decoupling and blinded blob signing): https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/61 and also updated the Deneb builder-spec diagrams on this page: https://hackmd.io/@jimmygchen/B1dLR74Io review & feedback welcome 🙏
